subject: Error in running DEC+j with areas allowed and time stratified matrix

messages.author: a65abcf2d8c47b08
messages.subject: Error in running DEC+j with areas allowed and time stratified matrix
parts:
Hi there everybody,

I've stumbled in a error while trying to run Dec+j with areas allowed and time stratified matrix.

Error in -details[[i, "hev"]]: invalid argument for unary operator

My code is this:
  1. ###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-
  2. # DECTSTA+j ####
  3. ###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-###-
  4. BioGeoBEARS_run_object = define_BioGeoBEARS_run()
  5. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$trfn = trfn
  6. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$geogfn = geogfn
  7. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$max_range_size = max_range_size

  9. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$min_branchlength = 0.000001    # Min to treat tip as a direct ancestor 
  10. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$include_null_range = TRUE    # set to FALSE for e.g. DEC* model, DEC*+J, etc.

  12. #Time stritefied:
  13. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$timesfn = timesfn2
  14. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$dispersal_multipliers_fn = dispersal_multipliers_fn2
  15. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$timesfn
  16. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$dispersal_multipliers_fn
  17. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$areas_allowed_fn = dispersal_areas_allowed_fn
  18. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$areas_allowed_fn

  20. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$speedup = TRUE         
  21. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$use_optimx = TRUE     
  22. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$num_cores_to_use = detectCores()
  23. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$force_sparse = TRUE    

  25. BioGeoBEARS_run_object = readfiles_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

  27. # Divide the tree up by timeperiods/strata (uncomment this for stratified analysis)
  28. BioGeoBEARS_run_object = section_the_tree(inputs=BioGeoBEARS_run_object, make_master_table=TRUE, plot_pieces=FALSE, fossils_older_than = 0.5)
  29. # The stratified tree is described in this table:
  30. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$master_table

  32. # Good default settings to get ancestral states
  33. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$return_condlikes_table = TRUE
  34. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$calc_TTL_loglike_from_condlikes_table = TRUE
  35. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$calc_ancprobs = TRUE    # get ancestral states from optim run

  37. # Look at the BioGeoBEARS_run_object; it's just a list of settings etc.
  38. BioGeoBEARS_run_object
  39. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$areas_allowed_fn
  40. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$list_of_dispersal_multipliers_mats[[4]]

  42. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object

  44. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table

  46. # Set up DEC+J model
  47. # Get the ML parameter values from the 2-parameter nested model
  48. # (this will ensure that the 3-parameter model always does at least as good)
  49. dstart = resDEC$outputs@params_table["d","est"]
  50. estart = resDEC$outputs@params_table["e","est"]
  51. jstart = 0.0001

  53. # Input starting values for d, e
  54. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["d","init"] = dstart
  55. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["d","est"] = dstart
  56. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["e","init"] = estart
  57. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["e","est"] = estart

  59. # Add j as a free parameter
  60. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["j","type"] = "free"
  61. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["j","init"] = jstart
  62. BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["j","est"] = jstart

  64. # Run this to check inputs. Read the error messages if you get them!
  65. check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

  67. # For a slow analysis, run once, then set runslow=FALSE to just 
  68. # load the saved result.
  69. runslow = TRUE
  70. resfn = "DIP_DECTSTAj.Rdata"
  71. if (runslow)
  72. {
  73.   res = bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
  74.   res    
  75.   
  76.   save(res, file=resfn)
  77.   resDECTSTAj = res
  78. } else {
  79.   # Loads to "res"
  80.   load(resfn)
  81.   resDECTSTAj = res
  82. }
What can this be?
Cheers.
